note: Every copy of the novel, which version each one holds, and what it was made from. Google Docs are named by title only: this repository is public, so their ids stay out of it. `holds` is what was recorded on the asOf date. `checked` says how that was established, or that it was not.

instances.title: FINAL StS Manuscript
instances.role: The author's Doc as it stood on 19 November, with his planning notes above the novel.
instances.checked: Drive lists its last edit as 19 November 2026. Its text was not compared with anything on 22 November.

instances.role: The repository copy of that Doc. Its commit history is the version history up to 19 November.
instances.checked: manuscript/novel/CHANGES.md records the pull. Not compared again on 22 November.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Final Manuscript
instances.role: The novel alone, 20 November. The first Revised Manuscript was made from it.
instances.checked: The Revised Manuscript's change log names it as the starting text. Which Doc it was made from was not checked.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Revised Manuscript
instances.role: Contradictions fixed, the 19 picture placeholders filled, the appendix added.
instances.checked: Its change log, dated 20 November 2026, says it was made from the Final Manuscript.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Revised Manuscript v2
instances.role: The fact-checked text: 204 claims checked, 13 changed.
instances.checked: The Fact-Check Log (v2) says its fixes were made in v2.

instances.title: The private reader at /novel/<key>/
instances.role: What a reader with the private link sees. One Markdown file for each section, in the order novel.json gives, with the 19 pictures.
instances.checked: novel.json names Revised Manuscript v2 as its source, and the commit that added it says 2,839 paragraphs were checked against that Doc.

instances.title: Surviving the Singularity, Revised Manuscript v3
instances.role: The book as it stood before version 4, which was made from it. It keeps its 19 pictures. Leave it as it is.
instances.checked: Compared with version 4 section by section on 22 November 2026: 32 of 47 sections differ. The 193 changes of the Revision Plan were not checked one by one against the text.

instances.title: OLD: v3 text-only copy from Nov 22 morning (not v4)
instances.role: Superseded. A copy of v3 made at 8:05 on 22 November with the 19 pictures and captions removed. It has none of the edits made to v3 after that. It was first titled Revised Manuscript v4.
instances.checked: Read back when it was made: 0 pictures, and the only text missing against v3 at that hour was the 19 captions.

instances.title: v4 scaffold
instances.role: The plan for version 4 and the place where sessions leave notes for the author. At the top: who is working on what, and "Waiting on you". Then the rulings ("Decided so far"), a profile for every character, the list of fixes, and four notes for every chapter. No prose.
instances.checked: Checked by Claude Code on 22 November 2026 against v3: 1,183 quotations, all in v3 except lines marked as cut or proposed. Claude Duet then updated it to match version 4; that update was not checked.

instances.title: StS Final Draft v4 Surviving the Singularity
instances.role: Version 4, kept as the safe fallback. Every line-level pass of 23 and 24 November went in here on the author's yes: the F list, the R, S, V and G check, and the P list. Left untouched once v5 was copied from it.
instances.checked: Read on 23 November 2026: 47 sections, about 80,260 words, 19 pictures, and 39 tracked suggestions from Claude Code waiting on the author. All 46 sections were read for the Editor's Letter. The author is editing it. Read back after each batch on 24 November: every change landed and nothing else moved, 19 pictures, no em dashes.

instances.title: StS v5 draft (Nov 23)
instances.role: The book right now, and the Doc being edited. A copy of v4 with six hands-on project scenes added in Chapters 26 to 34 on the author's calls. Since then, each on his yes: the polish passes, the new Ch 25 exchange where Elijah asks Marta about Grace, and Elijah's nicknames (Marta's "spreadsheet"; Lou's "Ivy League," "Thoreau" and "son"). Every change is listed in the StS Canon and Change Record. See manuscript/NOVEL-PROCESS-2026-11-23.md.
instances.checked: Read back on 24 November 2026 after the six scenes went in and the bonsai scene moved to the end of Chapter 32: 3,583 paragraphs, about 88,100 words (85,027 from Chapter 0 to the end of Chapter 39), no em dashes. Read back again on 24 November after the Ch 25 exchange and the 17 nickname lines: 3,608 paragraphs, no em dashes, and only the planned lines differed.

instances.title: The compendium at /novel/<key>/compendium
instances.role: Topics and entries about the people, places and things in the book. Written from v3 as it stood on the morning of 22 November. Out of date since: it still says Second Crop (now Crop Dust), and its Items entry is the Fisher woodstove, which v3 has replaced with an amp.
instances.checked: Every quotation in the six sample entries was searched for in that morning's text. Not checked against v3 since.

notes.what: A PDF of v3 made early on 22 November, before that day's edits.

notes.title: StS Preorders and Discount Codes (from Supabase, 2026-11-22)
notes.what: A spreadsheet another session made on 22 November. It holds customer data, so it is listed by title only and was not opened.

notes.title: StS v4 Chapter Arcs
notes.what: A story arc for each of the 46 sections, and the new chapter titles, written from version 4 by another session. Claude Code checked its 426 quotations against version 4: 6 are not word for word. The instructions it followed are in the Doc "Claude Code prompt: v4 chapter arcs and chapter titles" and on the branch novel/v4-arcs-titles-prompt.

notes.title: OLD: V3 to V4 Readiness Audit (made without seeing the book; see the Editor's Letter)
notes.what: Made by a tool that could not see the book. It contains nothing about the text. Replaced by the Editor's Letter.

notes.title: StS v4: Editor's Letter and Readiness Audit (Nov 23)
notes.what: The editorial read of version 4, 23 November: answers on arcs, sentences and voice, ten calls for the author, small continuity questions, notes for the Amazon file, and a punch list for all 46 sections. Its 124 quoted lines were checked against version 4.

notes.title: StS v4 final edits, Nov 23 (Drive folder)
notes.what: The Change log, the Scene pass and the Editing method from the final editing night. The Change log's last section, "v5 changes", logs every change made to v5 since 24 November, with the words before and after. The process is recorded in manuscript/NOVEL-PROCESS-2026-11-23.md.

notes.title: StS Canon and Change Record
notes.what: One entry for each decision the author makes about the book: the date, his words, and every file and place it changed. Started 24 November. In the Revision Notes folder. Repository copy: manuscript/NOVEL-CANON-AND-CHANGE-RECORD.md.

notes.title: Surviving the Singularity: Character Bible
notes.what: For each character: core motivation (marked as the author's call or proposed), backstory checked against v5, 2026 voice with three real v5 lines, and flags where the Drive character files disagree with v5. Elijah, Grace, Lou, Marta, David and Ma are done; the co-op table and the people outside it are to come. In the Revision Notes folder. Repository copy: manuscript/NOVEL-CHARACTER-BIBLE-2026-11-23.md. A Claude Doc with the same title is on claude.ai.

notes.title: Surviving the Singularity: Story Structure and Character Arcs
notes.what: The four-act structure of v5 and the arc of each main character, written from v5 on 23 November. In the Revision Notes folder. Repository copy: the file in manuscript/ whose name starts NOVEL-STORY-STRUCTURE (23 November). A Claude Doc with the same title is on claude.ai.
